items.title: Cobalt Labs payments platform exits beta with $4B in transaction volume
items.summary: Cobalt Labs announced general availability of its payments platform after a six-month beta. The company says it processed $4B in volume during beta with partners including Stripe.

items.title: EU publishes final PSD3 text; SCA exemption thresholds raised, new fraud-sharing rules
items.summary: The European Commission released the final PSD3 text overnight. Notable changes include raised strong customer authentication thresholds and a new mandatory fraud-data-sharing scheme among PSPs. Implementation deadline is 2027.

items.title: Lyra Finance raises $80M Series C led by Sequoia at $1.2B valuation
items.summary: Lyra Finance, a fintech competitor focused on cross-border payments, raised $80M in a Series C led by Sequoia Capital. The round values Lyra at $1.2B.

items.title: Stripe launches Issuing API in five new markets including Brazil and India
items.summary: Stripe expanded its Issuing product to five additional markets. Brazil and India support both virtual and physical card issuance.

items.title: Plaid faces class-action lawsuit over alleged data-sharing practices
items.summary: Plaid is the subject of a new class-action suit alleging that consumer banking data was shared with third parties beyond stated terms. Plaid denies the claims.

items.title: Lakers eliminated in Game 7 after late collapse
items.summary: The Lakers were eliminated from the playoffs after losing Game 7 by six points.

items.title: Taylor Swift announces 12th studio album, 'Reprise'
items.summary: Taylor Swift announced her 12th studio album, due October 2026.

items.title: Bitcoin crosses $200,000 for the first time on heavy ETF inflows
items.summary: Bitcoin briefly traded above $200,000 overnight as US spot Bitcoin ETF inflows hit a six-week high.

items.title: SEC charges crypto exchange Helios with offering unregistered securities
items.summary: The SEC filed charges against crypto exchange Helios for offering unregistered securities. Helios said it will contest the charges.

items.title: Anthropic releases Claude 5.0 with 2M-token context window
items.summary: Anthropic released Claude 5.0, featuring a 2M-token context window and improved tool-use reliability. Pricing remains unchanged from Claude 4.7.

items.title: GitHub Copilot launches agent mode in public preview
items.summary: GitHub announced public preview of Copilot's agent mode, which can autonomously edit multiple files and run tests. Available to all paid users.

items.title: Apple sets WWDC 2026 for June 8-12
items.summary: Apple announced WWDC 2026 will run June 8-12, online and in-person at Apple Park.

items.title: OpenAI announces Operator-2 with 50% fewer hallucinations on agent benchmarks
items.summary: OpenAI released Operator-2, an agent model the company says shows a 50% reduction in hallucinations on the AgentBench suite versus Operator-1.

items.title: FedNow transaction volume hits record 50M transactions in April
items.summary: The Federal Reserve's FedNow instant payments service processed a record 50 million transactions in April, up 38% from March.

items.title: Google Cloud us-east-1 outage affects multiple SaaS providers
items.summary: A two-hour outage in Google Cloud's us-east-1 region affected services including Snowflake and Notion. Resolved by 7pm PT.

items.title: OpenAI o5 sets new state of the art on reasoning benchmarks
items.summary: OpenAI's o5 reasoning model achieves a new SOTA on AIME 2026 and GPQA benchmarks.

items.title: Vercel introduces Fluid Compute pricing tier
items.summary: Vercel announced a new pricing tier that bills only for active CPU time, claiming up to 70% savings on agentic workloads.

items.title: PostgreSQL 18 released with native vector indexing improvements
items.summary: PostgreSQL 18 ships with improved pgvector integration and a new asynchronous I/O subsystem.

items.title: Marvel announces 'Avengers: Reckoning' cast at Cannes
items.summary: Marvel revealed the cast for 'Avengers: Reckoning' at the Cannes Film Festival.

items.title: Saudi PIF acquires gaming studio Embracer for $4.5B
items.summary: Saudi Arabia's Public Investment Fund agreed to acquire Embracer Group for $4.5B.

items.title: EU AI Act enforcement begins for high-risk AI systems
items.summary: The EU AI Act's enforcement provisions for high-risk AI systems came into force, with fines up to 7% of global revenue. Financial services AI is in scope.

items.title: Lyra Finance hires former Coinbase CFO as new president
items.summary: Lyra Finance announced it has hired Coinbase's former CFO as president, signaling a push into US enterprise sales.

items.title: WMO confirms 2025 was hottest year on record
items.summary: The World Meteorological Organization confirmed 2025 was the hottest year on record, 1.62°C above pre-industrial levels.

items.title: OpenAI signs deal with Walmart to deploy retail agents in stores
items.summary: OpenAI announced a multi-year deal with Walmart to deploy in-store AI agents for inventory and customer assistance, starting with 200 US stores.

items.title: Snowflake Q1 earnings beat on AI workload growth
items.summary: Snowflake beat Q1 estimates on revenue and EPS, citing growth from AI-related workloads.

items.title: Salesforce announces 1,500 layoffs as part of AI restructuring
items.summary: Salesforce announced 1,500 layoffs, primarily in sales and support roles. The company said it is reallocating headcount to AI product teams.

items.title: Cursor raises $200M Series B at $4B valuation
items.summary: AI coding tool Cursor raised a $200M Series B led by Thrive Capital at a $4B valuation.

items.title: DOJ files antitrust suit against Visa over debit network practices
items.summary: The US Department of Justice filed an antitrust lawsuit against Visa, alleging the company illegally monopolized debit card networks.

items.title: Manchester United wins FA Cup in extra time
items.summary: Manchester United won the FA Cup 2-1 in extra time over Manchester City.

items.title: New treatment shows 60% reduction in long Covid symptoms in Phase 3 trial
items.summary: A Phase 3 trial of a new monoclonal antibody therapy showed a 60% reduction in long Covid symptoms over 12 weeks.
